item.title: 'A major water main break': City of Holland planning repairs, water service disruption Tuesday
item.description: Many residents of Holland will lose water service Tuesday evening as crews work to repair a major water main break on N. Front Street.

item.title: Baylor Acrobatics & Tumbling: The quest for an 11th straight title
item.description: Baylor Acrobatics and Tumbling's season begins. The Bears are no stranger to success with ten straight championships in their trophy case and they are eyeing title number 11

item.title: Texas Education Agency says students, schools could face serious consequences for walkouts
item.description: Texas education officials issued new guidance Tuesday warning students, teachers and school districts of potential consequences for participating in or facilitating political walkouts during school.
